---
title: "2026 Florida Democratic Primary for U.S. Senate"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(plotly)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# Extract the 67 county precinct files to a temporary directory and read them in
files <- unzip("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", exdir = tempdir())

sen_dem_county <- read_tsv(
  files,
  col_names = FALSE,
  col_select = c(
    county = X2,
    office = X12,
    candidate = X15,
    party = X16,
    votes = X19
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(office == "United States Senator", party == "DEM") |>
  summarize(votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(county, candidate)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = candidate, values_from = votes, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(
    total_votes = `Alex Vindman` + `Angie Nixon`,
    vindman_pct = `Alex Vindman` / total_votes,
    nixon_pct = `Angie Nixon` / total_votes,
    county_key = str_to_lower(county),
    tooltip = paste0(
      "<b>", county, " County</b><br>",
      "Alex Vindman: ", comma(`Alex Vindman`), " (", percent(vindman_pct, accuracy = 0.1), ")<br>",
      "Angie Nixon: ", comma(`Angie Nixon`), " (", percent(nixon_pct, accuracy = 0.1), ")"
    )
  )

fl_counties <- counties(state = "FL", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  mutate(county_key = str_to_lower(NAME)) |>
  left_join(sen_dem_county, by = "county_key")

p <- ggplot(fl_counties, aes(fill = vindman_pct, text = tooltip)) +
  geom_sf(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    labels = label_percent(),
    name = "Vindman\nVote Share"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Democratic Primary for U.S. Senate",
    subtitle = "Alex Vindman share of the two-way vote (vs. Angie Nixon) by county"
  ) +
  theme_void()

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```
